mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to recover while TRANSIT stays less negative, commuting and in-person errands should widen the customer base for retail and recreation, pushing RETAIL_REC above its prior 4-week mean within one month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -26.0 to -15.6 over t-1w to t-0w while TRANSIT improved from -41.0 to -39.0
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not improve together and RETAIL_REC still rises, this commuting-driven mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL time signals substitution away from out-of-home shopping; when residents stay home more than about 10 points above baseline, RETAIL_REC should fall further over the next 1 to 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains at least 10 points above baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is elevated at 9.9 to 13.6 across the last four weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 and RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks, the home-stay substitution hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed below -35 while WORKPLACES are still negative, the persistence of mobility constraints should keep discretionary retail demand muted and prevent RETAIL_REC from rebounding over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -35 and WORKPLACES stays below -15
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -39.0 at t-0w and WORKPLACES is -15.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain weak but RETAIL_REC rises over the next month, the restriction-pressure mechanism is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility from very negative levels should spill over into nearby leisure retail trips, so a sustained weekly improvement in PARKS over the next month should lift RETAIL_REC with a short lag.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -32.0 at t-3w to -4.6 at t-1w before weakening to -21.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS improves again but RETAIL_REC does not rise within one week, the leisure-spillover hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in GROCERY_PHARM without a matching rise in RETAIL_REC indicates consumers are still reallocating trips to essentials, so stable or improving grocery access should keep discretionary retail demand from accelerating over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is near baseline while RETAIL_REC stays below baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is close to baseline (-1.3 at t-0w) while RETAIL_REC remains negative (-18.0 at t-0w)
failure_condition: If grocery mobility remains near baseline yet retail mobility rebounds strongly, the essentials-substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The recent divergence between improving WORKPLACES and persistently weak TRANSIT implies mode shift rather than a full mobility recovery; if that gap persists, retail visits should stay below the prior 4-week average over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises while TRANSIT remains below -35
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved to -15.6 at t-0w while TRANSIT stayed at -39.0
failure_condition: If workplace mobility rises but transit remains weak and retail still increases over four weeks, the mode-shift drag hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT of more than 3 points week-on-week should be followed by lower RETAIL_REC within one week because reduced access and weaker foot traffic immediately suppress discretionary shopping trips.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -41.4 at t-2w to -39.0 at t-0w, remaining deeply negative
failure_condition: If TRANSIT drops by more than 3 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not weaken within one week, the access-shock hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, outdoor recreation and home-based substitution crowd out shopping trips; under that combined regime, RETAIL_REC should decline relative to the last month over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases while RESIDENTIAL stays above 9
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed elevated near 10 while PARKS rebounded to -4.6 before falling again
failure_condition: If PARKS rises together with elevated RESIDENTIAL and RETAIL_REC still increases over four weeks, the substitution hypothesis is rejected.
